description: Trigger discrimination: which-skills record vs the task closeout report (ai-closeout-reporter). Both auto-invocable.

cases.prompt: Finish up: produce the skills-used record for this session and tell me where to paste it.
cases.reason: A which-skills-were-used record with manifest-bound hashes is the ledger's output; the closeout reports what the task did and omitted.

cases.prompt: The billing-export task is done. Write the end-of-task closeout report: what changed, what was intentionally not done, and the check commands.
cases.reason: The closeout itself - what was done, omitted, and verified - is ai-closeout-reporter; the ledger only records which skills were used.
